title: Render the extremes at every width
statement: Render a course's extremes, its longest word, option and sentence and its largest set of options, at phone, tablet and desktop widths, and again whenever new content extends one.
example: A desktop-only check battery missed all three classes of layout fault one visual audit found.
detail: The reading project's QC checklist asks that the longest word, longest option, longest sentence and largest option count render clean at 1280 and 390 pixels, again whenever new content extends an extreme, and at a third width in the 720 to 820 pixel band, which its walker never opened (`grade3-reading/artifacts/AlphaRead-QC-Checklist-v2-2026-09-04.md`). A visual audit found three faults, among them long button labels that overflowed the 390 pixel viewport and forced sideways scrolling, and the register's class rule was that the check battery was desktop-only, so all three were invisible to it (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-codex-visual-2026-09-07/REGISTER.md`).
